title: ChatGPT: AI Comes to the Web
description: A quick, practical guide to ChatGPT: AI Comes to the Web.

hook.text: On November 30, 2022, OpenAI launched a chatbot. It reached 100 million users in two months.

buildup.text: ChatGPT could write essays, explain code, and hold conversations that felt almost human.

discovery.text: It was delivered as a simple web app — just a text box and a submit button.

twist.text: The simplest possible web interface for the most complex AI model. Design echoed Google's homepage.

climax.text: ChatGPT proved that the web browser remains the best way to deliver transformative technology.

punchline.text: A text box delivered an AI revolution.

quiz.question: How quickly did ChatGPT reach 100 million users?
